cohort: Combined tracker; first qualifying (output ID, pure past identity, assigned truth) event, strong point score >=.525, affinity logit >= log(9); positive controls use the same filters.
sampling: At most 12 chronological evenly spaced published errors per scene with 4 future scans available; up to 36 evenly spaced correct controls. Uses previously exposed scenes only.
counterfactuals: One-shot oracle veto leaves point occupied; motion-only uses old position advanced to current update time and old velocity; full rollback restores track and association history, preserves public output. Neither intervention consumes truth in production.
readout: Separate onset vs next 4 scans; correct old-ID continuation, other-target outputs, outages, and predicted residual. Compare identical support observed in raw scans.
